replayMethod.decisionInput: Only the latest 16 consecutive completed 15m candles ending at each decision close.
replayMethod.candidateMode: INTRADAY (explicitly supplied after the v8/v9 version argument).
replayMethod.entry: Next 15m candle open; candidates without the next bar are excluded.
replayMethod.horizon: INTRADAY; at most 4 bars / 60 minutes, per existing v8/v9 mode.
replayMethod.sameBar: If stop and target are both touched in one candle, stop is selected first.
replayMethod.riskControls: Model assumptions only: each pool/arm has independent $400 starting equity. Risk size is min(current modeled equity, $1,000) × 1%, or 0.5% after two recent losses in the optional reduced-risk scenario, then limited by remaining $400-principal daily loss ($20), weekly loss ($40), and cumulative drawdown ($120) budgets after $2 reserve. V8 only gets a modeled 3-consecutive-loss/4h gate; v9 does not. Preserve 32 daily entries, $100 margin cap, 5–10x leverage, $1,000 notional cap, one position, 45m cooldown, -5% daily, -10% weekly, -30% cumulative, +20% daily cap. UTC account-loss buckets; PHT market decision window.
replayMethod.drawdown: Modeled maximum drawdown is settled-close equity peak-to-trough only; intratrade mark-to-market drawdown is unknown from OHLC and is not claimed.

lossStreakPolicy.v8: Modeled 3 consecutive settled losses blocks new entries for 4h after the last settled close.
lossStreakPolicy.both: Optional separate risk mode halves sizing after at least 2 consecutive settled losses when the last settled close was within 4h.

formalFinancialEvidence.reason: No point-in-time side-specific exact-notional quote, impact, fee, funding, borrow, or replayed risk-state evidence was captured.

netRewardRiskSensitivity.costs: MODELED ONLY; 10 bps or 20 bps round trip on each arm’s own notional. No observed production cost evidence.

recommendation: Keep net RR floor 1.5 unless point-in-time exact-notional cost evidence shows it prevents all feasible opportunities; these modeled sensitivities cannot justify relaxing it.
